verdict.rationale: Formant's marketing says users can "ask your fleet what's happening in plain language" and get ML-driven task recommendations that people approve. The analytics docs also mention an AI assistant for building dashboards. This shows natural-language querying and assisted dashboard building, but robot commands themselves are documented as predefined button-click actions or API-created custom commands, not issued in natural language. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of commands and teleoperation, in-depth docs on the plain-language assistant's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
